work_item: Verify that ExplainPrevious Recovery refuses a saved AskPreviousRelation result when its actor_memory_revision points at another retained snapshot where the premise has been invalidated
permission_scope: Continuing user authorization to implement in MINIDORA-BETA and retain work in its repository; local source test and focused checks, direct main commit/fast-forward push, and existing backup-reference rotation only.

runtime.managed_cloud_environment: The existing /workspace/MINIDORA-BETA checkout was ready and clean at batch start. Pinned Rust/Cargo 1.99.1 were invoked via their explicit toolchain path with system compiler paths. Git CLI remote reads and ls-remote succeeded.
runtime.remote_access: Repository reads/writes use Git CLI; no GitHub connector API, deployment or external action was used.

implementation.change_type: One Engine-library clone-only regression test; no production logic, schema, dependency, manifest or lockfile change.
implementation.producer: A normal Japanese AskPreviousRelation ResultRecord records its retained actor-memory revision and exact sealed input identity after committing a premise and direct question.
implementation.consumer: ExplainPrevious Recovery -> verify_previous_relation_context -> exact actor-memory snapshot lookup -> direct-premise replay.
implementation.route: Commit premise, direct question, AskPreviousRelation and ExplainPrevious through Engine; reopen Engine and confirm valid Recovery inspect; create a separate invalidation-case that invalidates the premise and retains a distinct snapshot; in a cloned CaseRevision only, repoint the prior result actor_memory_revision to that snapshot.
implementation.expected_and_observed: The clone preserves the prior result ID, input ID/version and sealed request identity. The invalidated snapshot contains the same Fact with valid=false. Recovery stops with RECOVERY_CONTEXT_PROOF_CHANGED because the prior relation no longer resolves to one direct premise in that snapshot. The original case latest revision and output bytes remain unchanged.
implementation.compatibility: B88-B91 revision-less and misbound-input boundaries remain separate cases; B92 tests a revision-bearing result whose revision pointer is rebound in a synthetic clone.
implementation.compatibility_limit: The malformed CaseRevision is synthetic and never persisted. No actual historical SQLite/schema record or migration was tested.
implementation.temporary_fixture_store_modified: The fixture records the premise invalidation in a separate case to create the later retained snapshot; fixture-owned state is cleaned after the test.
implementation.external_effects: None; fixture uses temporary local state and output, cleaned by the test fixture.

test_attempts.result: Initial attempt failed to compile because the reopened Engine binding was not mutable. After correcting the intended B92 binding, a run passed with an unnecessary-mut warning from an unrelated existing test; that unrelated change was reverted. The final clean retry passed: 1 passed, 0 failed, 285 filtered out.

not_run: Actual historical Rust-schema ResultRecord/SQLite reads, schema migration, persistent Store corruption/repair.
Full Engine/workspace runtime suites, workspace all-target Clippy, workspace all-features test/build.
CLI, HTTP, browser, other operating systems, large-history replay, every Recovery consumer and complete CAP-D02/E1 acceptance.
Independent QA, E2-E8, release and deployment.
